items.note: Honest limit; syr.limit.ritual-sequence covers missing service order, not a whole day, but sentence is a limit statement.

items.label: in_world
items.note: Formation logic: madrashe performed by choirs incl. daughters of covenant; also syr.story.qyama-morning.

items.label: partly
items.note: Font-as-womb carried; Physician in syr.dw.jesus. Adds hymns about 'the covenant's own promise' and attributes all to daughters' choirs.

items.label: partly
items.note: Covenanters fast and return to work carried; adds a daily pattern for ordinary non-vowed believers, whom the record leaves silent.

items.label: in_world
items.note: Faith as foundation stone with fasting, prayer, love, almsgiving built on it; also syr.dw.doubt.

items.label: partly
items.note: Covenant served fast, watch, vigil; 'stricter' and 'longer' than lay practice is an added comparative degree.

items.label: in_world
items.note: Covenant stayed in town among kin rather than leaving for the desert.

items.label: framing
items.note: Interpretive characterization of preceding penitence practice; no checkable specific claim.

items.label: framing
items.note: Connective restatement; no specific claim.

items.label: in_world
items.note: Preachers warn candidates before baptism using conflict/battle imagery (Dem. VII.20).

items.label: in_world
items.note: Paraphrase of Aphrahat's instruction that preachers warn before baptism.

items.label: framing
items.note: Restates preceding warning-before-baptism sentence as a transition.

items.label: in_world
items.note: Death and rising as one rescue carried in hymns/letters; also syr.dw.gospel-harmony.

items.label: in_world
items.note: Record names covenant vow taken before the water; sentence only sequences vow then baptism.

items.label: in_world
items.note: Womb and second birth carried; Jordan-font as raza/shrara in syr.core.syriac formation logic.

items.label: in_world
items.note: Teachers called baptism second birth in which the believer receives the Holy Spirit.

items.label: outside
items.note: No record mentions hearers, full membership, or change of status after baptism.

items.label: partly
items.note: Most people married (did not take vow) carried; taking the vow 'later', after baptism, is not carried.

items.note: Most people married and raised children; kin often did not share vow (syr.dw.cost-distance).
